September 17, 2025

Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement

For release at 2:00 p.m. EDT

  • Share

Recent indicators suggest that growth of economic activity moderated in the first half of the year.

In support of its goals, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point.

Voting for the monetary policy action were Jerome H. Powell, Chair; John C. Williams, Vice Chair.

For media inquiries, please email media@example.test or call 202-452-2955.
